title: 58HF+X8, Dubai
description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

raw_area: 687P+G8F - Al Jadaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

description:
A HOME DESIGNED TO MAKE LIFE FEEL BEAUTIFUL

There is a moment when you walk into a home and everything simply feels right.

The light.
The proportions.
The softness of the details.
The way every space seems to understand how you want to live.

This is the feeling behind Sky Harmony.

Set in Jumeirah Village Circle, Sky Harmony is more than a contemporary residence. It is a vision of harmonious living, brought to life through the design philosophy of Natuzzi Italia, one of Italy's most recognised names in luxury furniture and design.

Imagine coming home after a long day in Dubai and entering a space shaped by Italian elegance. Soft forms, refined neutral tones, natural textures and carefully considered interiors create an atmosphere that feels sophisticated without ever becoming excessive.

Here, luxury does not need to announce itself.

It reveals itself quietly.

Step outside your residence and the story continues. Start your morning with a swim, recharge in the gym, take a peaceful run, or simply retreat into your private jacuzzi and let the day slow down. Spend time with the people you love around the kids' pool and play areas, challenge yourself at mini golf, or lose yourself in a book in the library.

And when evening arrives, the atmosphere changes once again.

The lights soften. The city begins to glow. You gather with friends, order a refreshing mocktail and settle beneath the open sky for an outdoor cinema experience.

For those who desire something even more exclusive, selected residences offer private jacuzzis, while the penthouse experience takes luxury higher with a private rooftop pool.

Every element has been composed around one idea: life should move beautifully.

Sky Harmony is where Italian design meets the rhythm of Dubai, where comfort meets sophistication, and where your home becomes more than a place to return to.

It becomes the place where your life finds its perfect harmony.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 58XX+M4, Dubai
description: Creek Haven by Emaar introduces an elevated waterfront lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets the tranquillity of nature. Offering a thoughtfully designed collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, the development combines sophisticated architecture, soothing water views, and abundant natural light to create homes that feel both inviting and refined. Each residence is carefully planned to maximize space, openness, and comfort, with modern interiors defined by clean lines, understated details, and a harmonious palette of soft tones. Generous layouts and expansive views capture the peaceful atmosphere of Dubai Creek Harbour, creating a private retreat where residents can unwind and enjoy a more balanced way of living. The development offers an impressive selection of resort-inspired amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social connection. Residents can enjoy separate adult and children's swimming pools, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, a padel court, dedicated yoga and relaxation areas, children's play spaces, and beautifully landscaped gardens. These thoughtfully curated facilities encourage an active outdoor lifestyle while creating a welcoming community environment. The apartments are offered unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their individual tastes and preferences. High-quality finishes, contemporary kitchens, refined materials, and carefully considered details provide an elegant foundation for modern living. Blending functionality with understated luxury, Creek Haven creates a living environment designed for comfort and lasting appeal. Location: Dubai Creek Harbour Dubai Creek Harbour is a landmark waterfront destination envisioned as a distinctive blend of contemporary architecture, natural beauty, and urban convenience. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, this master-planned community combines residential living with leisure, retail, and recreational experiences along the historic Dubai Creek. One of the area's standout attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach destination featuring approximately 700 metres of white sand, a resort-style atmosphere, and picturesque sunset views. The wider community is designed to offer a family-friendly environment, with landscaped promenades, open spaces, and opportunities to enjoy the waterfront lifestyle. Dubai Creek Harbour is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. The wider destination reflects Dubai's vision for innovative urban development, bringing together contemporary design, sustainability, and a vibrant waterfront setting. With its scenic surroundings, lifestyle attractions, and thoughtfully planned community infrastructure, Dubai Creek Harbour offers an appealing residential destination for homeowners and investors seeking modern waterfront living in Dubai.

Imagine waking up to a place where architecture feels like art, the sea becomes part of your daily scenery, and every detail has been designed to make ordinary living feel extraordinary. Welcome to Villa dell’Arte, a boutique waterfront residence on Dubai Islands where contemporary elegance meets the freedom of island living.

The residences range from one to four bedrooms, including spacious duplexes, creating a collection designed for those who appreciate individuality, privacy and timeless style.

Step beyond your residence and the experience continues. Imagine an evening spent beside the infinity pool as the marina lights begin to shimmer, followed by an open-air movie beneath the stars. But true luxury is not only about what you see. It is about what becomes effortless. Villa dell’Arte introduces a lifestyle supported by carefully curated services, including access to chauffeur-driven Mercedes-Benz S 600 transportation, golf carts with drivers across the island, and an à la carte Riva motorboat with captain for private journeys on the water.

And then there is Dubai Islands itself — a waterfront destination created for a new generation of coastal living, offering beaches, marinas and a peaceful island atmosphere while remaining connected to the energy of Dubai. Downtown is approximately 20 minutes away, allowing the city’s culture, business and entertainment to remain within easy reach.

Villa dell’Arte is not simply where you live.
It is where your life becomes a work of art.

The Quayside is a premium residential project by Ellington Properties, ideally located in Business Bay, Dubai. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. description: Sei Saadiyat: 1-bedroom apartment offering approximately 78 sq m of space within a new residential development by Aldar in Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi. The residence features a light interior palette with stone, wood, metal and woven textures, combined with clean forms and carefully balanced proportions. The development comprises six towers and 778 residences. The architectural concept was created by Jacobs, while the interiors were designed by Kettle Collective. The project combines stepped building volumes, landscaped courtyards, elevated gardens and a façade treatment shaped by light and shadow. Sei Saadiyat is located in the heart of Saadiyat Cultural District, approximately 3 minutes from Abrahamic Family House, 4 minutes from Zayed National Museum, and around 5 minutes from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Grove. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi and teamLab Phenomena are about 7 minutes away, while Yas Island is around 20 minutes and Zayed International Airport approximately 25 minutes away. With approximately 78 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to owner-occupiers and buyers considering future rental within Saadiyat Cultural District. Its proximity to the island's major cultural landmarks is one of the project's defining advantages. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2030 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 5% payable on booking, 45% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Sei Saadiyat is the combination of an Aldar development, a prime cultural district location and a distinctive architectural concept. Surrounded by tranquil creek views, striking skylines, and lush green landscapes, this exceptional residential destination offers a harmonious blend of serenity, contemporary design, and urban sophistication. One of the area's distinctive attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach designed to bring a relaxed coastal atmosphere to the heart of the community. Together with the area's contemporary skyline, waterfront promenades, and carefully planned public spaces, these features contribute to its distinctive identity. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a lifestyle that combines scenic surroundings with convenient access to retail, dining, and leisure experiences. Its emphasis on open spaces, waterfront living, and modern urban design makes it an appealing choice for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and natural tranquillity. With its striking views, evolving skyline, and vibrant waterfront atmosphere, Dubai Creek Harbour represents a compelling vision of contemporary living in one of Dubai's most distinctive residential destinations.

title: 682W+2J, Dubai
description: Creek Bay by Emaar introduces an elegant residential experience in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, where contemporary architecture meets the tranquillity of waterfront living. Offering a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, the development combines modern design, natural light, and thoughtfully planned spaces to create homes that feel both sophisticated and welcoming. Designed with Emaar's signature attention to quality, each residence features contemporary interiors, clean architectural lines, and well-proportioned layouts that maximise space and comfort. The calming atmosphere and waterfront surroundings create an inviting retreat from the pace of city life, while the development's modern aesthetic complements the distinctive character of Dubai Creek Harbour. Resort-Inspired Amenities & Outdoor Living Creek Bay offers a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, recreation, and community living. Residents can enjoy: Adult swimming pool and children's pool Indoor and outdoor fitness facilities Dedicated padel court Yoga and relaxation areas Children's play areas Landscaped gardens and outdoor leisure spaces Every amenity is designed to encourage an active yet relaxed lifestyle, providing opportunities for fitness, family time, and social connection within a beautifully planned residential setting. Contemporary Interiors & Personalised Living The apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes and preferences. High-quality finishes, modern kitchens, subtle colour palettes, and functional layouts create a refined foundation for contemporary living. With a focus on comfort, practicality, and understated elegance, each home offers the flexibility to create a personalised living environment while enjoying Emaar's established design standards. Prime Waterfront Location - Dubai Creek Harbour Dubai Creek Harbour is an expansive waterfront destination spanning approximately eight square kilometres, envisioned as a vibrant urban community combining contemporary architecture, leisure, retail, and residential living. Set along the historic Dubai Creek, the destination offers a distinctive blend of waterfront scenery, landscaped promenades, dining destinations, and outdoor experiences. Creek Beach, a signature lifestyle attraction within the community, features approximately 700 metres of white sand, creating a relaxed beachside atmosphere complemented by an infinity pool and picturesque sunset views. raw_area: Villa Del Garda, Dubai Islands, Dubai
description:
WHERE ITALIAN ELEGANCE MEETS THE ART OF WATERFRONT LIVING

There are homes you enter, and there are residences that make you feel as though you have stepped into another world.

Welcome to Villa del Garda, a first-row waterfront residence on Dubai Islands, where the calm of the marina meets the timeless elegance of Italian design.

Imagine arriving home to an atmosphere created around beauty, comfort and effortless sophistication. Every residence is fully furnished and fully equipped, with bespoke Italian kitchens and custom-made Italian wardrobe systems crafted specifically for the project. European craftsmanship, refined materials and carefully selected interiors create a turnkey home where nothing feels added as an afterthought.

Then comes the view.

Beyond the elegant interiors, the marina opens before you, bringing the rhythm of the water into everyday life. Mornings begin with serene horizons, afternoons flow beside the infinity pool, and evenings become moments to remember as the sky changes colour above the Arabian Gulf.

The experience continues with a private clubhouse, fitness facilities, concierge and 24-hour security, while in-house golf carts make moving around the island effortless. For those who want to take luxury even further, à la carte services include a chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce and a private Riva motorboat with captain, available for pre-booked experiences.

With residences ranging from refined apartments to exceptional duplexes and private terrace-pool residences, Villa del Garda offers a rare interpretation of waterfront living — intimate, serviced and unmistakably sophisticated.

Set on Dubai Islands, just minutes from the city's established destinations, this is where the energy of Dubai meets the serenity of the sea.

Villa del Garda is not simply a residence by the water. It is a private expression of Italian elegance, where every arrival feels special and every day carries the atmosphere of a five-star retreat.

description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Project visuals propose a calm, polished interior language of warm timber, pale stone, tailored lighting and broad glazing. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately fifteen minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is around forty-five minutes away. Drive times are indicative and depend on traffic. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1356. The building is located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, in one of the city's most prestigious locations, close to urban landmarks and with easy access to major thoroughfares and business, retail and leisure centres. The construction scheme is organised with several floors: underground, support/podium floors, residential floors and technical mechanisms, offering a total of dozens of floors for housing, with a limited number of units, which contributes to the exclusivity of the development. This project was designed for those looking to live in the city centre with its pace, conveniences and services without giving up comfort, luxury and privileged views. raw_area: Siniyah Island, Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, Umm Al Quwain
description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. description: Binghatti Skyblade is a striking residential development that redefines contemporary urban living through bold architecture and sophisticated design. Distinguished by its blade-inspired silhouette, crystalline glass façades, satin chrome accents, and sculpted balconies, the tower creates a dynamic architectural statement against Dubai's skyline. The development offers a collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed with open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an emphasis on natural light, spaciousness, and seamless interior flow. The development features a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to complement modern living. Residents can enjoy rooftop infinity swimming pools, dedicated wellness and spa facilities, fully equipped fitness centres, landscaped recreational areas, and children's play zones. Complemented by thoughtfully designed communal spaces, these facilities create an inviting environment where relaxation, recreation, and social interaction come together. The combination of elevated leisure facilities and contemporary conveniences enhances the overall residential experience. The residences feature modern interiors finished with quality materials and refined detailing. Smart home technology adds convenience and functionality, while equipped kitchens provide practical solutions for everyday living. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Combined with efficient layouts, contemporary finishes, and expansive windows, the homes offer a sophisticated canvas for modern urban living. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant districts, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and upscale lifestyle. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountain, the area offers an exceptional blend of retail, dining, entertainment, and hospitality experiences. Its dynamic atmosphere and distinctive urban character make it a sought-after destination for residents, professionals, and international visitors. The district features an impressive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, fine-dining restaurants, and high-end shopping destinations. From designer boutiques and vibrant cafés to entertainment venues and cultural attractions, Downtown Dubai offers a lifestyle defined by convenience and sophistication. Its pedestrian-friendly areas and access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro, also make it an appealing choice for residents who prefer convenient connections to key destinations across the city. Strategically connected to Sheikh Zayed Road and major road networks, Downtown Dubai provides access to important business and residential districts, including Business Bay and other central areas. Its proximity to commercial hubs, transport links, and everyday amenities supports a well-connected urban lifestyle. With its combination of iconic landmarks, premium facilities, and vibrant city living, Downtown Dubai remains one of the city's most recognisable residential and investment destinations.

title: WELCOME TO YOUR SAFTY HOME ENJOY AL FURJAN LIVING
description:
Imagine yourself living here...

Imagine opening your eyes and your balcony isn't a balcony. It's a private garden in the sky. Green plants wrapped around you, a big wicker egg chair, and soft fairy lights tangled in the leaves. No noise. No traffic. Just green, quiet, like you're in a resort.

You walk inside... It's fully furnished, premium finishes, everything is done. You walk into the bathroom and you feel like you walked into a spa. Marble, hidden LED glow under the sink, a big mirror, and a calm vibe that makes you forget you're in an apartment.

You go downstairs... The swimming pool is not a building pool, it's a resort. Sun deck, a cabana with woven pendant lights and golden glow, lit palm trees, and a space where you can sit with your family like you're on vacation every day.

Want to work out? The gym is not just a gym. It's floor-to-ceiling glass with the whole city in front of you, brand new equipment, and a quiet yoga area where you can breathe away from the world. Your kids have their own safe, closed play zone.

And at night? It's a whole different story. The pool glows blue, your balcony is full of golden lights, and the entire Dubai skyline lights up in front of you. Marina and JBR glowing in the background like you're watching a movie.

And the best part? You're in Al Furjan. That means the metro is at your doorstep. Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are 2 minutes away. Marina is 10 minutes, Ibn Battuta Mall is 5 minutes, and all your work, schools, and life are around you. It's the most in-demand rental area in Dubai right now. Everyone wants to live here.

So whether you live in it and feel that resort life every day... or you rent it out and get a high rental yield because everyone is looking for this area... you win.

This is not an apartment... This is a full resort life, with interest-free installments, pre-launch prices, and limited units.

*Imagine yourself living it... before someone else takes it.*

description: Allegro Park is a residential building by Mill Hill Developers on Dubai Islands, set where the coastline meets a green park setting. The architecture is designed to blend into its surroundings, with gentle façades, shaded balconies and open breezeways. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, as well as penthouses and townhouses, and every apartment features a private glass-sided plunge pool on the balcony. The amenity offer brings resort-style living to the building. Residents can enjoy a podium beach-edge pool with a natural sand entry, an adults' rooftop infinity pool and an adults' rooftop cinema, as well as a temperature-controlled podium cinema. A Technogym fitness centre, a spa and wellness centre with saunas, steam rooms and plunge pools, and a podium-level padel court support an active lifestyle, while a splash pad and a children's play area cater to families. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished with kitchen appliances. Interiors follow a modern and contemporary style that pairs natural palettes with refined textures, creating calm and light-filled living spaces with a resort-style lobby welcoming residents on arrival. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods with beaches, marinas, hotels and leisure facilities. The area offers a relaxed coastal lifestyle with open sea views and green spaces, while remaining closely linked to the established districts of the city. Dubai Islands Beach is only moments away, and Dubai Creek is within a short drive. Dubai International Airport, Dubai International Financial Centre and Downtown Dubai are reachable via the main road network, while Dubai Marina can also be accessed by road. Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of beachfront living, marina and hospitality offerings and convenient access to the city's business and travel hubs positions the area for both end users and investors seeking waterfront homes in Dubai.

Situated along the Dubai Canal, it offers a perfect blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a top choice for professionals and families alike. Advanced smart home automation is seamlessly integrated, allowing residents to control lighting, climate, blinds, multimedia, and even guest parking from touch panels or a mobile app. Bathrooms include elegant finishes and mood lighting, while the overall design emphasizes energy, flow, and a joyful, balanced lifestyle within a sophisticated urban sanctuary. description:
WHERE THE CITY SLOWS DOWN, AND LIFE BEGINS TO FEEL DIFFERENT

There are places that simply put you close to the city.

And then there are places that let you experience the city without becoming overwhelmed by it.

West 5 Residences is designed for the second kind of life.

Imagine waking up in the heart of Dubai, with the energy of the city only moments away, yet your morning begins at a slower pace. Natural light fills your home, greenery softens the view, and the day starts with the feeling that everything you need is already within reach.

Set in Jumeirah Garden City, West 5 brings a refined residential atmosphere to one of Dubai's most connected urban locations. Its contemporary architecture and open, spacious residences create a home that feels modern without losing its sense of warmth.

Step outside and your day takes a different direction.

Take a refreshing swim. Begin your workout in the gym. Spend time surrounded by landscaped gardens. Let the children enjoy their own spaces while you unwind, gather with friends around the barbecue or simply take a quiet moment away from the city's rhythm.

And when you want the energy back, Dubai is waiting.

Downtown, Dubai Mall, DIFC and the city's iconic destinations remain within easy reach, while Jumeirah Garden City's central position keeps your everyday journey beautifully connected.

With elegant one- and two-bedroom residences, West 5 is created for people who want more from their address — more comfort, more connection, more balance and more meaning in the way they live.

Because the true luxury of living in Dubai is not being surrounded by everything.

It is knowing you can reach everything, while still having a place that feels entirely yours.

Residents can choose from stylish studios, one-bedroom apartments in two thoughtful layouts and spacious two-bedroom homes, while ground-level retail units bring everyday convenience right to the doorstep. Life at the tower centres on a beautifully landscaped podium deck with a sparkling swimming pool, comfortable sunloungers, a shaded cabana and relaxed lounge seating surrounded by lush greenery. Arrival is equally impressive, with a grand double-height glazed lobby beneath a stone canopy, a landscaped drop-off area and multi-level podium parking wrapped in a sculpted louvred facade. Every home is designed to feel light and open, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural daylight. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Warm neutral tones, premium stone and elegant bronze accents carry the building's refined character from the facade all the way inside, delivering a truly polished and sophisticated living experience. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

Surrounded by lush landscapes and thoughtfully integrated into the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate community, the development offers a peaceful residential setting with convenient access to Dubai's key destinations. Its contemporary architecture features graceful curves, clean lines, and warm, earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the surrounding hills, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury and refined sophistication. The development presents an exclusive collection of branded one- to three-bedroom apartments and townhouses, thoughtfully designed to deliver privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance. title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: WHERE NATURE BECOMES YOUR NEW WAY OF LIVING
raw_area: Distrikt at Ghaf Woods, Ghaf Woods, Dubai
description:
WHEN THE FOREST BECOMES PART OF YOUR EVERYDAY LIFE

Imagine waking up in Dubai...

Not to the sound of traffic, not to concrete stretching endlessly across the horizon, but to a different kind of morning — one surrounded by trees, fresh air and the quiet feeling that nature is finally part of your everyday life.

This is the story of Lyra at Ghaf Woods.

Set within one of Dubai's most distinctive forest-inspired communities, Lyra introduces a new way of experiencing urban living. Here, your home doesn't simply stand within a neighbourhood. It becomes part of a landscape designed around greenery, movement, wellbeing and connection.

Step inside your residence and the feeling continues.

Contemporary interiors open towards natural light, creating a calm and elegant setting where the outside world feels beautifully close. Whether you choose a one- or two-bedroom residence, the spaces are designed for modern life while keeping a sense of warmth and privacy.

Then, instead of taking the elevator down into another concrete cityscape, you step outside into something different.

Walk beneath the trees.

Take your morning run along the trails.

Cycle through the landscape.

Pause beside the forest pools.

Let the children discover their own world through nature gardens and outdoor spaces, while you find a quiet moment for yourself at the wellness and yoga pavilion.

At Ghaf Woods, nature is not decoration.

It is the lifestyle.

And when you want to reconnect with the energy of Dubai, the city remains within easy reach, with Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road nearby.

Lyra is for those who want a home that feels different the moment they arrive — a place where mornings are calmer, evenings feel lighter and everyday life has room to breathe.

Because sometimes, the greatest luxury in a city like Dubai isn't being closer to everything.

It's having a place where you can finally slow down.

The two curved balconies trace the suite's outer façade and are planned as separate outdoor settings rather than a single narrow ledge. This creates several ways to use the outdoor space while preserving the distinction between private and social rooms. Project visuals propose a tailored contemporary interior of warm timber, pale stone, restrained colour and layered lighting. Broad glazing draws the horizon into the principal rooms, while the sequence of kitchen, dining room, lounge, study and bedroom gives the property a genuine sense of residence within a five-star hotel. The hotel amenity programme includes a rooftop swimming pool and pool bar, specialty restaurant, spa and sauna, gymnasium, business lounge and grand ballroom. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Al Hamra Mall is approximately five minutes away, Al Hamra Golf Club seven minutes away, Al Marjan Island eight minutes away and Wynn Al Marjan Island around ten minutes away. Existing rental channels and listings transferable to the new owner.

description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

This project represents a forward-thinking residential destination that combines modern living, strong investment potential, and a balanced lifestyle within one of Dubai's fastest-growing and most visionary districts. Terra Woods is designed to promote wellbeing and community living, offering a wide range of lifestyle amenities including adult and children's swimming pools, yoga lawn, outdoor gym, jogging tracks, sports courts, meditation gardens, BBQ areas, and recreational spaces. Built on the site of Expo 2020, it offers world-class infrastructure with a focus on sustainability, making it an ideal place for those looking to live in a forward-thinking community. Residents can enjoy lush green spaces, shaded walkways, and beautiful public parks, all carefully designed to create a peaceful atmosphere in the heart of the city. A network of solar-powered buildings, clean energy systems, and pedestrian-friendly areas showcase Dubai's commitment to an eco-conscious lifestyle. Every aspect of the area reflects a vision for a greener, healthier future for both residents and visitors. The neighborhood is known for its cultural richness and innovation, with iconic landmarks like Al Wasl Plaza, the Terra Sustainability Pavilion, and the Mobility Pavilion, all preserved from Expo 2020 and integrated into the community. Living here means easy access to a variety of art installations, cutting-edge technology exhibits, and interactive spaces that bring culture and creativity to everyday life. A mix of retail spaces, restaurants, and entertainment options are thoughtfully planned, providing endless leisure opportunities right at your doorstep. Expo City Dubai also hosts a variety of events and festivals throughout the year, ensuring a lively social scene for families and young individuals. In addition to cultural and leisure facilities, Expo City Dubai prioritizes convenience and connectivity. The neighborhood has direct metro access, connecting residents to other parts of Dubai within minutes, making it ideal for daily commuters. High-quality schools, medical centers, and fitness facilities are located nearby, ensuring that essential services are easily accessible. The area is also highly walkable and bike-friendly, supporting an active lifestyle for residents of all ages. Expo City Dubai offers a perfect blend of tranquility and excitement, making it an exceptional choice for those seeking a unique urban lifestyle in Dubai.

description: Avarra by Palace by Emaar introduces a refined expression of luxury inspired by the signature elegance of Palace Hotels & Resorts. The development presents an exclusive collection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, complemented by a prestigious 6-bedroom penthouse. Designed as serene private retreats, the residences combine contemporary architecture, expansive glass façades, and sweeping balconies that frame views of the sea, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai skyline. Every residence is thoughtfully crafted with premium materials, warm tones, and elegant detailing that reflect the refined craftsmanship associated with the Palace brand. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool with panoramic views, a dedicated yoga zone, fully equipped gym, and outdoor fitness areas. The neighbourhood has evolved beyond its commercial identity into a vibrant lifestyle destination. Residents have access to an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, hotels, fitness facilities, retail destinations, and entertainment venues, while the Dubai Water Canal introduces a more relaxed waterfront dimension to the surrounding urban landscape. The canal's promenades and waterfront spaces provide opportunities for walking, cycling, leisure, and enjoying the city's illuminated skyline. The combination of contemporary architecture, waterfront surroundings, and a diverse lifestyle offering makes Business Bay particularly appealing to both residents and investors. With its central position, strong connectivity, established amenities, and continued development, Business Bay offers a compelling blend of urban convenience and premium city living. Every element has been composed around one idea: life should move beautifully.

Sky Harmony is where Italian design meets the rhythm of Dubai, where comfort meets sophistication, and where your home becomes more than a place to return to.

It becomes the place where your life finds its perfect harmony.

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. raw_area: 67JW+P2W - Za'abeel - Al Kifaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower B, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.
