Set on the second floor of Aqua Arc on Al Marjan Island, this residence spans 1,217.93 sq ft (113.15 m²), combining an 850.99 sq ft interior with a remarkable 366.94 sq ft private balcony. More than thirty per cent of the property is dedicated to outdoor space, giving the apartment a scale and openness that its bedroom count alone does not reveal. Inside, the plan feels like a complete home rather than a compact holiday unit. The 3.0 by 2.2 metre kitchen leads naturally into a 5.8 by 4.0 metre living and dining room. This principal space is broad enough to accommodate defined lounge and dining settings, then opens directly onto the curved balcony for an effortless indoor-outdoor sequence. The bedroom measures 5.1 by 3.9 metres, allowing the sleeping area to retain a calm, well-proportioned character. It is supported by a generous 3.0 by 2.6 metre full bathroom. A separate guest powder room keeps visitors away from the private accommodation, while the dedicated laundry removes day-to-day utility from the kitchen. Together, these supporting spaces make the apartment far more suitable for extended stays than a typical one-bedroom layout. The balcony is the defining feature. At approximately 34.09 m², it has the proportions for open-air dining, a comfortable lounge arrangement and quiet private use without forcing every function into one narrow strip. Its curved edge follows Aqua Arc's wave-inspired architecture and gives the home a genuine outdoor room rather than a token balcony. The residence carries a community outlook. It is therefore best suited to a buyer who values interior scale, usable outdoor space and a calmer inward-facing position over a direct-sea premium. That distinction should be clear from the outset: the value here comes from proportion and liveability, not from an overstated view claim. Aqua Arc is designed as a contemporary waterfront address with flowing façades, landscaped arrival spaces and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones. Project visuals illustrate the intended design language; final materials, fixtures, appliances and furnishings must follow the executed sale documents. The planned resident amenities include indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established waterfront and hospitality corridor. For an international second-home buyer, the oversized balcony and complete supporting rooms make the apartment practical beyond a short visit. raw_area: Business Bay, Business Bay, Dubai, Dubai
description: Exclusive Fully Furnished Apartments in Business Bay Dubai Business Bay, Dubai's premier business and lifestyle hub, is a vibrant district that seamlessly blends luxury living with a thriving commercial environment. Known for its iconic skyline, Business Bay offers a mix of world-class residential towers, state-of-the-art office spaces, and high-end retail outlets. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it provides breathtaking waterfront views and easy access to major landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. With an array of fine dining restaurants, stylish cafes, and leisure destinations, Business Bay is a dynamic urban destination perfect for professionals, families, and investors seeking a modern and upscale lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street just 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera, 11 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project boasts a striking 102-floor tower with an iconic exterior crafted from high-quality materials, including premium marble, brushed gold detailing, and luxurious finishes such as white and gold marble and carbon fiber accents. Its design combines elegance and functionality with breathtaking aesthetics. Residents can enjoy over 40 premium amenities, including a private pool in every apartment, an infinity pool with canal views, a skyline spa, and a rooftop garden. It also features a wellness club, aquatic gym, indoor and outdoor party spaces, a sky meditation deck, and multiple lounges. Recreational facilities include a bowling center, mini-golf, cross-fit zones, a Zumba deck, a piano walk, and a musical deck. Sports enthusiasts can access cricket, badminton, basketball, and tennis training courts. Family-friendly features include kids' play areas, a trampoline zone, daycare, and a kids' oasis pool. Additional conveniences like a business center, library, beauty salon, health bar, and doctor-on-call services ensure a luxurious and well-rounded lifestyle. The project offers studios, one, two, three, four, and five-bedroom residences, featuring interiors that redefine luxury and elegance. Each unit is fully furnished with Exquisite Dolce Vita-branded furniture, crafted from premium Italian materials and showcasing meticulous attention to detail. The interiors include fitted wardrobes, stylishly designed to maximize space, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, blending practicality with sophistication. The living spaces are adorned with luxurious finishes, including marble flooring, fine wood accents, and high-thread-count linen curtains, while the bathrooms are enhanced with premium Italian fittings. Additionally, each residence is equipped with advanced smart home technology, providing seamless control of lighting, climate, and security to enhance convenience and modern living. Every element, from the convertible kitchens to the opulent grooved doors with golden details, embodies an exceptional standard of craftsmanship, creating an environment of unmatched comfort and refined beauty. title: LIVE ABOVE THE ORDINARY, SURROUNDED BY GREEN
raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower A, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

description: Elan Tower: fully furnished 1-bedroom apartment in Dubai Land Residence Complex offering approximately 49 sq m of space within a new residential development by Alfulaiti Development. The apartment features a separate bedroom, an open-plan kitchen and living area, dedicated storage space and a practical layout designed for comfortable everyday use. Residents will have access to an indoor swimming pool, gym, landscaped gardens, children's play area, on-site restaurants and CCTV security. The development combines compact residential layouts with everyday leisure and service facilities within a 16-storey building. Elan Tower is located in Dubai Land Residence Complex, approximately 5 minutes from GEMS schools and nurseries in Dubailand, around 15 minutes from Global Village, about 20 minutes from Dubai Mall and Downtown Dubai, and approximately 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The area also provides convenient access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. With approximately 49 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to a single professional, couple or buyer considering long-term rental. Full furnishing reduces the additional setup required after handover, while the freehold ownership structure makes the property available to buyers of all nationalities. Handover is scheduled for Q1 2029 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 20% payable on booking, 30% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Elan Tower is the combination of a furnished 1-bedroom format, staged payment plan and access to the growing Dubailand residential area. description:
WADI HILLS | WHERE MODERN LIVING MEETS EVERYDAY COMFORT**

Wadi Hills by HRE Development is a contemporary residential address in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), where the pace of city life meets the comfort of a thoughtfully designed home.

Imagine starting your day in a bright, welcoming space, with natural light flowing through floor-to-ceiling windows and every detail designed to make everyday living feel effortless. Whether you are choosing a stylish studio, a one-bedroom retreat, or a spacious three-bedroom home, Wadi Hills offers furnished residences with open-plan layouts and refined finishes, creating a setting that feels both practical and inviting.

Beyond your front door, a lifestyle of relaxation and wellbeing awaits. Take a refreshing swim in the infinity pool, enjoy a workout in the smart gym, or unwind in the sauna and dedicated wellness spaces. Landscaped surroundings offer room to slow down, while the children’s play area gives younger residents a place to enjoy their day. From the welcoming lobby and concierge services to convenient parking and high-speed elevators, every element is designed to bring ease to your daily routine.

Set within DLRC, Wadi Hills places you within reach of the wider city while allowing you to enjoy the growing community around you. With convenient connections to Al Ain Road (E66) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), commuting and exploring Dubai becomes simpler, whether your day takes you towards business districts, shopping destinations, or leisure attractions.

With 140 residences across a contemporary 13-storey building, Wadi Hills brings together comfort, convenience, and modern design in one address. An attractive 10% down payment, followed by 50% during construction, 10% on handover, and 30% post-handover, adds flexibility to the purchase journey. With handover scheduled for Q1 2028, Wadi Hills is an opportunity to make your next chapter in Dubai feel closer than ever.

description:
Only 162 residences on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah carry the Six Senses name. This is one of them.

Six Senses Residences The Palm is the first address in the Middle East and North Africa to wear the brand: a partnership between Select Group and Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas, part of IHG.

This two-bedroom residence faces outward across the ocean with accompanied sunset and skyline views. Midday light all the way through to evening, illuminating the sea. The JBR skyline and Dubai Ain holding the horizon. It is the postcard the city sells itself on, and only a handful of floor plates own it.

Step inside and the palette does the talking quietly. Travertine underfoot, warm wood joinery, brass detailing that will age into character rather than date. Deep terraces pull the view through the living space.

The layout is written for how people at this level actually live. Two bedrooms, every one of them fully en-suite, so guests, children and extended family are accommodated without a single compromise. A separate study for the work that does not stop at six. A technical kitchen sitting behind the show kitchen, so chefs, caterers and staff operate invisibly on entertaining nights. A dedicated maid's quarters with its own service access, keeping the household running out of sight.

Below you sits the reason people choose this building over every other tower on the island. Six Senses Place is a 60,000 sq ft wellness and lifestyle club reserved for residents: Six Senses Spa and hammam, indoor lap pool, Finnish and infrared saunas, private treatment rooms, a full gymnasium, squash, tennis and padel courts, co-working suites, a children's club and direct beach access. Resort-style pools and landscaped gardens beyond. Hotel-standard service on call, from housekeeping to in-room dining, delivered by the most credible wellness operator in global hospitality.

Consider what that combination protects. Branded residences in Dubai continue to trade at a firm premium over comparable unbranded stock, and land on Palm Jumeirah is finite by design. A completed, wellness-branded, sea-facing three-bedroom on the West Crescent is not a product that gets built again next season. It is replaced by nothing.

At AED 19,950,000, you acquire a finished asset, a globally protected brand, a fully managed lifestyle, and a view that can never be built out. Freehold. Ready to move into.

Private viewings are by appointment. Serious enquiries welcomed.

Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. title: WHERE EUROPEAN ELEGANCE MEETS THE MARINA
raw_area: Le Chateau Pietrus, Dubai Islands, Dubai
description:
Some homes offer an address. Others create a feeling that stays with you.

Le Château Piétrus is designed for the second kind of life.

Set on a first-row marina position at Dubai Islands, beside a landscaped park, it brings together the serenity of waterfront living and the refinement of a private European retreat. Only 86 fully furnished and serviced residences are arranged across seven residential floors, creating an intimate world where privacy, design and hospitality shape everyday life.

From the moment you enter, the experience feels different. Natural travertine, Italian Calacatta marble, curated European interiors and approximately 3.20-metre ceilings create a sense of warmth and space, while panoramic glazing opens the home towards the marina and park. Every residence is delivered turnkey, so you can step directly into a world designed around comfort and elegance.

The real story begins beyond your front door.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a distinctive mixed-use development by Binghatti, introduced under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." Rising above a shared podium, the development comprises two towers of contrasting heights defined by a sculptural and fluid architectural silhouette. The project brings together a selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Royal Suites, dedicated office spaces, and retail destinations, creating a contemporary environment that combines residential and commercial living with panoramic views across Dubai. Designed around an active and social lifestyle, Binghatti Spectre offers an extensive collection of leisure and wellness facilities. Residents can enjoy dedicated adult and children's swimming pools, a yoga and aerobics platform, paddle and tennis courts, and a jogging and sprint lane. Family-oriented spaces include a children's play area, comfortable sitting areas, and social nooks, while wellness facilities, lounge platforms, open lawns, and recreational tables including ping-pong provide opportunities for both relaxation and entertainment. The residences are thoughtfully planned across a range of layouts, from efficient studios to spacious three-bedroom homes. Larger residences offer enhanced features such as private pools, sky-open terraces, and dedicated laundry areas, creating a more elevated residential experience. Interiors are organized into distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites incorporated into the larger configurations. Modern finishes, quality materials, and contemporary detailing complete the homes, which are delivered unfurnished to allow residents to personalize their living spaces. Location Description & Benefits Located in Al Jaddaf , Binghatti Spectre benefits from an emerging waterfront neighborhood positioned along Dubai Creek. The area occupies a strategic location between the historic districts of Old Dubai and the city's established business and lifestyle destinations, including Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This central positioning provides convenient access to major road networks such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, while Dubai Metro and Creek transport connections further enhance accessibility. Al Jaddaf offers a distinctive combination of heritage, culture, waterfront surroundings, and modern urban development. The neighborhood is connected to Dubai Creek, one of the city's most historically significant waterways, while nearby cultural destinations add to its appeal. The Jameel Arts Centre contributes to the area's growing creative and cultural identity, creating an environment that extends beyond conventional residential living. The community continues to develop as a vibrant residential and commercial destination, with modern apartment buildings, waterfront residences, landscaped walkways, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport is another major advantage, particularly for frequent travelers and international residents. With its central location, growing waterfront appeal, strong connectivity, and proximity to Dubai's established business and lifestyle districts, Al Jaddaf offers attractive long-term potential for both end-users and investors. Binghatti Spectre combines this strategic setting with distinctive architecture, diverse residence options, and resort-style amenities, creating a contemporary destination designed for modern urban living.

title: DIFC Heights Tower
description:
DIFC Heights Tower is the second residential development from Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), following DIFC Living. The mixed-use tower stands on Al Mostaqbal Street in DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre), between Index Tower and DAMAC Park Towers, and rises to ground plus 47 floors, with 32 residential floors and seven commercial floors. Its 366 homes range from one-bedroom apartments of 871 sq ft to four-bedroom duplexes of 3,618 sq ft, with two- and three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes in between.

Interiors use pastel tones, high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, and the homes are semi-furnished, with Bosch kitchen appliances in the apartments and Miele in the duplexes. Shared facilities include a gym, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, a family lounge, an indoor kids' play area, a multipurpose hall and a co-working space, alongside landscaped terraces at the podium and amenity levels. The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. The payment plan is 5% on booking, 65% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1215. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai, a 450-metre-tall, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto the sea and skyline, providing abundant natural light and a continuous sense of spaciousness. Private balconies extend this connection to the landscape, while interior finishes including porcelain floors, fully equipped kitchens with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms with premium materials guarantee comfort, quality and sophistication in every detail. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this development represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's most impressive and elevated residential projects. Combining waterfront views, distinctive architecture, and an extensive range of lifestyle amenities, this development offers a sophisticated residential experience where coastal tranquillity meets the energy of Dubai's urban landscape. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront district strategically positioned near Dubai's historic commercial areas and major maritime infrastructure. Developed as a specialised hub for the maritime industry, the district brings together marine services, shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, and supporting commercial activities within a dedicated environment. The area features specialised facilities, including shipyards, dry docks, marine equipment suppliers, and maritime service zones. Educational and professional training facilities further contribute to its role as a centre for maritime expertise, supporting industry development and innovation. Alongside its commercial significance, the district's waterfront setting adds to its appeal as an emerging location for contemporary residential developments. Its strategic position provides convenient road access to established parts of Dubai, including Port Rashid, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Connections to major transport routes and nearby port facilities also support access to key commercial districts and international trade networks. Dubai Maritime City's combination of waterfront surroundings, commercial importance, and connectivity makes it an increasingly distinctive part of Dubai's urban landscape. description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

description: Beachfront Apartments with Post-Handover Payment Plan on Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, stretching 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf and offering over 7 kilometers of white-sand beaches and 23 kilometers of waterfront promenade. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. With upcoming landmark developments such as Nobu and the Wynn Resort, Al Marjan Island is rapidly emerging as a premier destination for waterfront living, tourism, and high-return real estate investment, just 45 minutes from Dubai. , are ideally located just 2 minutes from Wynn Resort, 12 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 13 minutes from RAK Central, 14 minutes from Al Hamra Golf Club, 16 minutes from the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, 30 minutes from RAK Mall and Al Qawasim Corniche, 35 minutes from RAK International Airport, 50 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai. The project rises 16 storeys above the Arabian Gulf on Al Marjan Island, designed as a sculptural icon that cascades organically towards the sea, blending architecture with nature to create an exclusive waterfront sanctuary. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Residents are welcomed through a grand arrival drop-off and a striking residential lobby, with direct access to retail outlets at the ground level. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. The design palette embodies understated elegance, featuring soft neutral tones, premium finishes, and the incorporation of natural materials like stone to create a calm, organic ambiance. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors, enhancing the connection to nature and creating private sanctuaries for relaxation. The interiors are a harmonious balance of functionality and style, crafted to deliver comfort, sophistication, and a lifestyle rooted in both beauty and practicality. RKT-00021
